purpose: Analytics charts for dataset, validation, errors, and split quality.

dataset_overview.description: Bar chart of final labeled dataset class counts (DISINFO, HATE, NORMAL) from datasets/labeled/annotator_a_llm.csv.
Bar chart of final labeled dataset source counts (gossip_lanka, youtube, elakiri).
Heatmap showing source vs label counts to visualize class balance by source.

validation_performance.description: Confusion matrix (raw counts) for the latest validation/test split model evaluation.
Row-normalized confusion matrix for the latest validation/test split; each row sums to 1.
Grouped bar chart for precision, recall, and F1-score by class on the latest validation/test split.
Overall validation/test scores: Accuracy, Macro F1, and Weighted F1 for the latest run.
Histogram of model confidence on validation/test predictions using max class probability per sample.

validation_error_analysis.description: Bar chart of validation misclassification counts grouped by true class.
Box plot comparing model confidence for correctly vs incorrectly predicted validation samples.
Validation accuracy grouped by source to show source-level reliability.
Validation macro F1 grouped by source for class-balance-sensitive source quality comparison.
Comparison of raw vs threshold-tuned validation metrics (Accuracy and Macro F1).
Horizontal bar chart of the most frequent validation misclassification directions (true -> predicted).

split_analysis.description: Side-by-side bar chart comparing class counts between train and test/unseen splits.
Side-by-side bar chart comparing class ratios between train and test/unseen splits.
Side-by-side bar chart comparing source counts between train and test/unseen splits.
Stacked ratio chart showing class composition differences between train and test/unseen splits.
